meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it? And I'll want to know what you're relying on besides a machine.
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
"Like, being stuck" is not a wrong answer from a seventeen-year-old asked cold, Hale. I'll want a copy of that note, with the date on it. What else do you have?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
I'm writing down October 15. Students change their minds between an outline and a final draft, Hale, that's what an outline is for. Show me the outline.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.
"If it holds up." You still haven't shown me that outline, Hale. Whatever happens, nothing goes on his record and nobody in that class hears a word of this.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record, and you said you would put that offer in writing. I still want to see the October 15 outline you described, and I want your assurance that nothing goes on Owen's record and that none of this is discussed in front of his class. I expect that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she agreed to nothing yet and still wants to see the outline, a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record, and the matter kept away from his classmates.
What moved her: you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which took the procedural fight off the table, and then you named a dated outline tied to his own work.
What cost ground: you made the rewrite offer before showing her the outline, so your strongest evidence was still only your description and she had nothing she could check herself.
Try next time: when you mention the October 15 outline, put it on the screen and let her read the date before you move to the Thursday rewrite offer.
